about: The auth host's public door (SA1, PL-26), in one place: apps.bicep compiles it, and the policy (public-doors), deploy.ts console and the infrastructure plan read it through auth-door.ts. Each route is one path prefix, in its one case unless anyCase (Zitadel's paths are case-sensitive, so another case would only widen the door), to one app, first match wins. `browser` is always open: what a person's browser needs to sign in, nothing more. The login app (v4.20.5) calls Zitadel only from its server, inside the environment (ZITADEL_API_URL): its browser code holds no gRPC-web client and no Zitadel service name (checked in the pinned image's .next/static, S206 at v4.20.3 and S207 at v4.20.5), so no gRPC service is in `browser`. /assets/v1/ is, since the login pages show the instance's branding (logo, font) from there. `console` is Zitadel's own console, its hosted login and the gRPC-web services its browser code calls (grpc.service.ts at v4.17.3, unchanged in v4.19.5, v4.20.3 and v4.20.5, makes every client it has): closed by default, so Zitadel's admin and management APIs are reachable from nowhere outside. It is opened only for a piece of work and closed straight after (node deploy/azure/deploy.ts console --open, then --close), and apps always deploys it closed. When open, its routes sit after `browser` and before `fallback`. `fallback` sends every other path to the API, which answers every request on the auth host with a plain 404 (apps/api/src/login-host.ts).
